verification_report.summary: All assertions in the submitted supplement passed sequential and reference verification. The proof correctly derives the attained bounded-truncation threshold for arbitrary nonzero nonnegative L1 densities, and its fat-set construction gives the claimed positive smooth-test threshold with no positive scaled subsolution when v_-(h)=0. The review confirmed the strict-domination orientation, per-index bounded tail envelopes, capacity and damped convergence passage, division only off poles, Lp scalar continuity, Markov remainder, and exact smooth-test value. No finite undamped-mass or limiting-equality assertion was used.
